HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

5. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   B. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   B. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

10. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

13. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

14. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

15. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   C. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Global governance 3.5 1st Generation of industrial revolution in Europe and Afri and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Global Governance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The 1st Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and conflict transformations in Kenya 4.2 Digital citizenship technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and Conflict transformations in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Digital citizenship technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
